name: Metal Container Corporation - Newburgh NY Can Plant

fieldNotes.truckGate: Main entrance off Breunig Rd (SW) is a wide open driveway with a '130' AB monument sign on a landscaped median - no barrier arm, sliding gate, or checkpoint. Street View Aug 2023 confirms open campus-style frontage with no perimeter fence at the road. A second access road on the NE connects to the broader internal road network; the small peaked-roof structure at that junction is a utility/storage building, not a guard booth.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth at either access point. The NE junction structure is a house-like utility building set back from the road, not a checkpoint booth.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: No gate exists, so no remote check-in either.
fieldNotes.entryExitSeparate: The main SW driveway serves the primary entry and the office/parking, while a separate NE road connects the truck-circulation perimeter loop - functioning as distinct in/out points on different sides of the property.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock banks appear on two distinct building faces - a row of dock doors with parked trailers on the SW/west face (warehouse side) and a separate dock cluster on the NE face of the building.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: Counted roughly 20-22 dock doors total across the SW/west face and NE face at zoom 19-20; estimate, some obscured by trailers and shadow.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Two clusters of trailers parked angle-nose-in storage style in the west truck yard - approximately 15-18 trailers visible.
fieldNotes.trailerParkingCapacity: West yard could hold ~30-40 trailers; estimate from paved area extent.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur visible entering the property; nearest rail is well off-site.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Facility sits in wooded terrain on the edge of New Windsor with only scattered light-industrial and residential development nearby - small-town/edge-of-town setting, classified Rural.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Single large connected structure - a warehouse section (NW, large flat roof) joined to a manufacturing section (SE, with rooftop process equipment and silos).
